t: Facades hide XNet cables by mimicking another block. Use the facade item on a block to copy it, then place it over an XNet cable.
伪装块通过模拟其他方块外观来遮蔽XNet线缆。对目标方块使用伪装块物品以复制其外观，随后将其覆盖于XNet线缆之上。
Connectors can also be hidden with facades. Breaking the facade reveals or restores the cable setup behind it.
连接器亦可通过伪装块隐藏。破坏伪装块即可显露或恢复其后方的线缆布局。
